title: Engraved region from a circle
description: A 16.5 x 16 mm circle converted to an engraved region. PE-DESIGN 11.50 cuts the fill's 4 mm stitches to 1.9 mm on average inside (262 needle points per cm2 against 128 outside); so does OpenStitch since #471 (2 mm steps: 1.94 mm, 263 per cm2; 1 mm before, 480).

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-10 capture 471-engraved-region-circle.pes (SHA-256 e76ec38316080f9fadcdeaa02eec9f075a6baad40609664aed689f3ac1228e8f, 3531 stitches; the owner's, not in the repository until PES 0110 import reads a shape that carries a stamp), measured for #471

measurements.evidence: 3,568 stitches: 392 more than the plain square (PE-DESIGN 280 more; about 860 more before #471) at #471, on the 40 mm square
